first_storyboard.title: Sleep Apnea and CPAP in Heart Failure

scenes.narration: If you have heart failure and trouble breathing at night, you may have obstructive sleep apnea. A CPAP mask can improve sleep and reduce daytime sleepiness. Tell your doctor if you snore or feel tired.
scenes.visual_description: Patient in bed with CPAP mask, partner listening, doctor chart.
